snippet.title: Dungeons & Desserts - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Watch the Announcement Trailer for Dungeons & Desserts, a roguelike dungeon crawler developed by Top Chop Games. Players will embark on a grand adventure through candy-themed landscapes to find rare ingredients, craft desserts, and manage the business of the bakery. Keep business flowing in Dungeons & Desserts, coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo launching in February 2026.
